_doc: Site orchestration + manifesto voice. Design: a narrative-led public index gray canvas, navy structure, orange accent. Voice: contract/voice_guide.json.

cinematic.title: Reindustrialisation runs on power the market still prices as damage.
cinematic.lede: The queue is ~125 GW deep. The connections clearing fastest are non-firm — interruptible by contract. NFRI scores who carries that exposure, who is prepared to underwrite it, and where the two diverge.

hero.title: Reindustrialisation runs on power the market still prices as damage.
hero.lede: Interruptible grid access creates a liability class the damage stack was never built to price — lawful curtailment without fault or material loss. Risk transfer still organises around proximate cause and breakage; availability sits outside the trigger. NFRI maps who bears that exposure, who the market is structurally prepared to underwrite, and where the two allocators diverge.
hero.thesis: The argument is the product. The scatter is the provisional test. Capacity deploys onto whoever looks exposed on a damage view — but losses concentrate where exposure runs ahead of preparedness.

pillars.title: Score the unscored
pillars.text: A population nobody had ranked on interruptible-power risk — made legible from registers and filings alone, the way a narrative-led public index made AI transformation legible for PE.

pillars.title: Encode the rubric
pillars.text: Physical-world seriousness: arithmetic in code, evidence tiers on every rating, fusion by credibility — not a model's free-text opinion.

pillars.title: Two axes, one number
pillars.text: Margin of Safety = Preparedness − Exposure. One glance should show who is carrying a bet they cannot support.

pillars.title: Ship it honest
pillars.text: L5 publication gate on every build. PROVISIONAL until measured share clears 60% — eval as epistemic hygiene, not disclaimer theatre.

items.title: Connection reform
items.text: Firmness becomes a register fact — Gate 1/2 is the measurement substrate.

items.title: Affordable electrons
items.text: Flexible queue clearance trades curtailment for speed — up to 80% cheaper connections in global pilots; the cost is already in constraint data.

items.title: Availability cover
